test_is_unique_series: test the is_unique method on a polars Series to identify rows that appear exactly once
test_is_unique_dataframe: test the is_unique method on a polars DataFrame to identify duplicate rows across all columns
test_is_unique_expr: test the is_unique expression on a polars DataFrame column via select to produce a boolean mask
test_is_duplicated_series: test the is_duplicated method on a polars Series to identify rows that appear more than once
test_is_duplicated_lazyframe: test the is_duplicated expression on a polars LazyFrame column via select and collect
